question: Can unsupervised object slots and masked latent prediction support balls planning and position probes; does masking help over O0?
hypothesis: Explicit object slots can preserve physical information absent from global latents; masking need not help for independently moving white balls.

sources.sections: Section 4.2 equations 3-6, Appendices B, D.2, D.3, E, G and H
sources.consequence: Keep an earliest-frame identity anchor, use bidirectional masked prediction, distinct action tokens, history/future losses and paired unmasked ablation.

sources.sections: Sections 3.1-3.3; Appendices C.1, C.5 and C.6 (local full PDF/text)
sources.consequence: Reuse sequential Slot Attention and transformer carry; RGB reconstruction is a local SAVi-style adaptation, not VideoSAUR training.
Keep L0/L1 reference runs and separate representation probes from planning success.

differences: Approved local deterministic RGB reconstruction replaces stochastic SAVi's KL term. n+2 slots rather than fixed seven. Stride one instead of Push-T frame skip five. Source inspection corrects the initial whole-history-mask wording: the first history frame remains the identity anchor; selected identities are masked in the remaining two history frames, using a linear projection of that anchor. No entity position embeddings. This correction is made before training, as authorized by the source-inspection clause of the plan. No paper code is copied.
contrary_evidence: Objects in this world do not interact; a hidden independently moving ball cannot be inferred from other balls alone. Masking can hurt. Reconstruction can bind background or split one object; no label-driven checkpoint selection is allowed. Dense DINO-WM is deferred, so no slots-versus-dense superiority claim.

encoder.decoder: 8x8 broadcast, three stride-2 transpose convolutions of width64, RGB and mask

slot_training.epoch: all 95 six-frame windows per episode once, shuffled

predictor.loss: masked history MSE plus future MSE

predictor_training.selection: minimum fixed validation future latent MSE
predictor_training.pairing: O0 and O1 same initialization, pre-extracted slots and per-epoch order; masks have their own generator

protocol.inference: Deterministic initial slots from one fixed Gaussian sample per slot, repeated across batch; continuous carry within history, independently initialized goal; B001 CEM and Hungarian final-goal cost.
protocol.probes: Train-only linear readout; red position and lexicographically sorted white positions, at current and four-step future time. Apply same sorting at fit/score, no label-dependent latent matching. Report per-axis Pearson and episode-cluster CI; shuffle actions and no-rollout controls. Training seeds separate.
checks: masked identities retain first anchor only
O0/O1 initial weights and order equal
no labels loaded by slot/predictor trainer

success: At H4, O1 >= L1 minus 10 percentage points and >= L0 plus 30 at every n; n3 current position Pearson >=0.9 and four-step white position Pearson >=0.8. Retain unexpected L0 success; do not tune to force the claimed gap.
stop: Failed numerical checks block training or interpretation; budget exhaustion is incomplete, not a negative result. Reserve P26 allocation before extra seeds.
